name: @thirdlight/mcp-adapter
description: Thirdlight M1 MCP adapter (decision 0001 S5, charter S7, packet 11): the MCP server tools (bounded project/entity inspection, command submission, session listing, play start/stop, bounded diagnostics, screenshot from the selected connected browser) routed into the backend application services over the same /api/v1 surface the browser uses - never a second mutation engine. Pure Node library (no Node builtins - dependencies.md S4.3 node: []): global fetch for the backend HTTP client, stdio transport for the harness. Edges (dependencies.md S4.1/S4.3): protocol, backend (the /services subpath only), @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.
